events.title: US Q3 GDP advance estimate
events.why_it_matters: Atlanta Fed GDPNow has cut Q3 growth to 3.5%, and the first print will test whether the soft-landing narrative survives hot inflation and weak housing.
events.what_to_watch: Consumption and inventory contributions; a sub-3% print would pull forward easing expectations.

events.title: US September PCE inflation
events.why_it_matters: Core PCE is the Fed's preferred gauge and follows a hot September CPI; a 3%+ core print would harden the December hike case.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE m/m and supercore services; any upside surprise lifts front-end yields and hits duration-sensitive equities.

events.title: China October manufacturing PMI
events.why_it_matters: A print above 50 would confirm Q3 momentum; below 50 would revive stimulus expectations.
events.what_to_watch: New orders and export sub-indices for trade-deal impact.

events.title: US October ISM manufacturing
events.why_it_matters: Manufacturing has been a soft spot; a print near the 54.5 prior would confirm the economy is holding up despite high rates.
events.what_to_watch: New orders and employment sub-indices; a drop below 52 would add to growth concerns ahead of the December Fed meeting.

events.title: US Conference Board consumer confidence
events.why_it_matters: Michigan sentiment has fallen to a 15-year low, and the Conference Board print will show whether the labour-market view is deteriorating ahead of the holiday season.
events.what_to_watch: Expectations and labour differential; a weak print would hurt discretionary retail and support duration.

events.title: Brazil presidential runoff — Bolsonaro vs Lula
events.why_it_matters: Flávio Bolsonaro led the first round and polls, and a runoff win would extend the market-friendly rally in Brazilian assets; a Lula comeback would reverse it.
events.what_to_watch: Final polls and turnout in Sao Paulo; Ibovespa, BRL and Petrobras reaction.

events.title: OPEC+ monthly meeting — production held for November
events.why_it_matters: OPEC+ has held November production steady after completing prior increases, and with Hormuz risk premium elevated the meeting could tighten or loosen the market.
events.what_to_watch: Compliance language and any hint of retaliatory supply action if Iran disruptions worsen.

events.title: Venezuela–Guyana Essequibo dispute escalates
events.why_it_matters: Venezuela has authorised oil exploration in disputed waters and Exxon is pressing ahead, while the US has warned Caracas against attacking Guyana or Exxon assets.
events.what_to_watch: Any military incident or Exxon evacuation; a disruption would add a second oil-risk premium.

events.title: EU long-term budget impasse after October summit
events.why_it_matters: EU leaders ended the summit without a breakthrough on the next multiannual budget, leaving energy support and Ukraine funding unresolved.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a special summit is called before year-end; failure raises fragmentation risk in EU assets.

events.title: UK Autumn Budget — bank tax in focus
events.why_it_matters: Chancellor Healey's first Budget is expected to avoid raising capital gains tax and instead target banks to fill a fiscal gap, with gilt and sterling sensitivity high.
events.what_to_watch: Bank surcharge and fiscal headroom; a bigger-than-expected bank levy hits UK bank shares and could steepen gilts.

events.title: China restricts export of AI and chip-design technologies
events.why_it_matters: Beijing added 23 AI technologies to its export-control list and imposed immediate registration on outbound frontier models and chip IP, escalating tech fragmentation.
events.what_to_watch: The November 15 registration deadline and whether Washington retaliates with tighter semiconductor equipment controls.

events.title: US Section 301 China exclusions expire November 10
events.why_it_matters: 178 product exclusions expire and no extension has been announced, which would raise costs for importers just as the broader truce runs to January 10, 2027.
events.what_to_watch: A last-minute USTR extension; failure would hit hardware and industrial importers with retroactive tariff exposure.

events.title: Samsung Electronics full Q3 results
events.why_it_matters: Preliminary guidance showed a record ~$80bn operating profit on AI memory demand, and the divisional breakdown will confirm whether the HBM cycle still has legs.
events.what_to_watch: HBM revenue mix and capex plans; a cautious memory outlook would hit the Korean chip complex and SK Hynix.

events.title: Coordinated global port strike
events.why_it_matters: Dockworkers across more than 100 ports plan a coordinated strike, threatening container flows and adding to supply-chain inflation just as holiday shipments peak.
events.what_to_watch: Participation at Los Angeles/Long Beach, Rotterdam and Piraeus; a multi-day stoppage would lift freight rates and hit retailers.

events.title: China October LPR decision — held at 3.0%/3.5%
events.why_it_matters: The LPR was unchanged for a 17th month, signalling the PBOC is prioritising bank margins and a policy-rate overhaul over near-term stimulus.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the PBOC shifts its policy anchor to the overnight reverse repo, which would change how markets price Chinese easing.

events.title: Netflix Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Ad-tier engagement and pricing trends set the tone for streaming margins and the media complex into year-end.
events.what_to_watch: Ad-supported subscriber mix and free-cash-flow guide; a miss would weigh on communication services.

events.title: Hurricane Isaias — Gulf Coast landfall, now post-tropical
events.why_it_matters: The first Atlantic hurricane of the season made landfall on the Gulf Coast and disrupted some oil/gas and refining operations, but has since weakened.
events.what_to_watch: Insurance loss estimates and any lingering refinery outages; the storm is no longer a market driver.

events.title: UAW strike ends with tentative GM deal
events.why_it_matters: The tentative deal removes a supply-chain disruption for GM and reduces the risk of contagion to other automakers.
events.what_to_watch: Ratification vote and whether the deal sets a costly pattern for Ford and Stellantis.

events.title: US-China Kuala Lumpur trade framework extended; reciprocal tariff cuts on $30B of goods
events.why_it_matters: Removes the November 10 tariff-expiry tail risk and locks in a pause on reciprocal measures through January 2027, supporting global trade and tech supply chains.
events.what_to_watch: Implementation details and whether the 100% tariff threat is formally withdrawn; any Chinese retaliation in non-tariff areas.

events.title: Trump waives Russia energy sanctions and 100% tariffs under Graham Act
events.why_it_matters: Lowers oil supply risk and removes a tariff overhang for major EM importers, but signals unpredictable US sanctions policy.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the waiver holds or is reversed; impact on Russian crude flows and Indian/Chinese refining margins.

events.title: Fed Chair Warsh dovish remarks; October hike odds fall below 15%
events.why_it_matters: Reduces the probability of a pre-election hike and supports duration-sensitive growth stocks.
events.what_to_watch: Whether other Fed officials push back hawkishly before the October 27-28 FOMC.

events.title: US September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y; core 2.6%
events.why_it_matters: Sticky inflation keeps the Fed hawkish and raises the bar for rate cuts into year-end.
events.what_to_watch: September PCE on October 29 for confirmation of the inflation trend.

events.title: US September retail sales +0.8% m/m, well above expectations
events.why_it_matters: Consumer resilience supports the soft-landing narrative despite weak payrolls and hot inflation.
events.what_to_watch: Whether holiday-season guidance from retailers confirms sustained demand.

events.title: TSMC Q3 beat-and-raise; net profit +68.7% y/y, record sixth straight quarter
events.why_it_matters: Confirms AI chip demand remains robust and supports the semiconductor supply chain.
events.what_to_watch: Nvidia's November 17 earnings and capex guidance from hyperscalers.

events.title: ASML Q3 record sales €11.7B, net income €5.0B; strong Q4 guidance
events.why_it_matters: Signals sustained AI-driven demand for advanced lithography and boosts the European tech complex.
events.what_to_watch: Whether export-control tightening affects 2027 order intake.

events.title: JPMorgan Q3 profit miss, first since 2023
events.why_it_matters: High rates are pressuring bank margins and credit costs, a warning for the financial sector.
events.what_to_watch: Other bank earnings and loan-loss provisions for credit deterioration.

events.title: China Q3 GDP +4.5% y/y, beats 4.4% consensus; Q/Q +1.2%
events.why_it_matters: Growth is stabilizing at the bottom of the target range but remains unbalanced, with weak consumption and property.
events.what_to_watch: October PMI on October 31 for momentum into Q4.

events.title: China September retail sales +1.1%, industrial production +5.5%
events.why_it_matters: Confirms a two-speed economy: factories strong, households cautious.
events.what_to_watch: Any new consumption stimulus ahead of the dual sessions.

events.title: China LPR held at 3.00% / 3.50% for 17th consecutive month
events.why_it_matters: A hold signals caution on stimulus; the PBOC instead signaled a shift to DR-based policy rate anchoring.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the PBOC cuts the 5-year LPR in November to support property.

events.title: Netflix Q3 revenue $12.87B (+12%), EPS $0.87 beats; stock falls
events.why_it_matters: Ad-tier and engagement trends set the tone for streaming and media, but valuation remains stretched.
events.what_to_watch: Q4 guidance of $13.4B and ad-tier monetization commentary.

events.title: Hurricane Isaias shuts 63% of Gulf of Mexico oil production
events.why_it_matters: Gulf Coast landfall disrupted oil/gas production and refining, with insurance losses.
events.what_to_watch: Production restoration timeline and impact on refined-product cracks.

events.title: UAW strike ends after tentative GM deal
events.why_it_matters: Removes a supply-chain disruption for GM and the auto sector.
events.what_to_watch: Ratification vote and whether the deal becomes a template for other automakers.

events.title: Boeing engineers approve 4-year contract, averting strike
events.why_it_matters: Removes a production disruption risk for Boeing's delayed jetliners.
events.what_to_watch: Delivery cadence and whether the deal improves labor relations.

events.title: US East/Gulf Coast port strike ends after three days
events.why_it_matters: Avoids a prolonged supply-chain shock, though a second strike risk remains.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a new contract is ratified before the next deadline.

events.title: Supreme Court overturns Humphrey's Executor, expands presidential control over SEC/FTC/FCC
events.why_it_matters: Significantly shifts regulatory independence, with long-term implications for enforcement and rulemaking.
events.what_to_watch: How agencies adjust enforcement priorities and whether Congress responds.

events.title: India Supreme Court strikes down Yes Bank AT1 write-off
events.why_it_matters: Restores ₹8,415 crore to bondholders and sets a precedent for AT1 instruments globally.
events.what_to_watch: Whether other jurisdictions revisit AT1 write-down precedents.

events.title: Fed Beige Book: modest growth, rising price pressures
events.why_it_matters: Supports a hawkish hold at the October FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the October 27-28 FOMC statement acknowledges slowing growth.

events.title: Reuters survey: 94/100 economists expect October hold, all expect December hike
events.why_it_matters: Crystallizes the 'skip October, hike December' consensus, limiting surprise risk at the FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: The December 9-10 FOMC meeting and the November 6 payrolls report.

events.title: SEMICON West 2026 highlights $1 trillion semiconductor milestone
events.why_it_matters: Conference commentary reinforced AI-driven demand and capex plans.
events.what_to_watch: Follow-through in equipment orders and Nvidia's November earnings.

events.title: Tesla Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: EV demand, margins, and autonomy/robotaxi updates are key for the sector and the Musk premium.
events.what_to_watch: Automotive gross margin (consensus ~15-16.5%), adjusted EPS (~$0.23), and free cash flow.

events.title: Meta Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AI capex and ad demand will test the market's tolerance for spending; EPS expected to fall 8% y/y.
events.what_to_watch: Ad revenue growth (~23%), capex guidance, and Reality Labs losses.

events.title: Jio Platforms IPO opens (India's largest-ever IPO, ₹30,213 crore)
events.why_it_matters: A record Indian IPO tests global risk appetite for EM tech assets and could catalyze more listings.
events.what_to_watch: Subscription levels, GMP (~22% listing gain signal), and post-listing performance.

events.title: Bank of Korea rate decision
events.why_it_matters: Unanimous hold at 3.00% expected, but guidance on a November hike matters for KRW and Korean assets.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the BOK signals a November hike as 28/33 economists expect.

events.title: Japan national CPI (September)
events.why_it_matters: Informs the BOJ's October 29-30 decision; yen and JGBs are sensitive to any upside surprise.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI (prior 1.9%) and whether yen weakness is feeding into import prices.

events.title: FOMC rate decision
events.why_it_matters: 94/100 economists expect a hold at 3.75%-4.00%; the market is pricing ~15% hike odds, so a hold is the base case.
events.what_to_watch: Statement language on inflation, dissent count, and Warsh's press conference tone.

events.title: Microsoft fiscal Q1 2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Azure growth is the key test of AI capex returns; consensus ~45% cc growth, with a high bar.
events.what_to_watch: Azure growth vs. 44-45% guided, Copilot monetization, and capex commentary.

events.title: Alphabet Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Cloud and Search growth will be scrutinized for AI monetization and ad resilience.
events.what_to_watch: Google Cloud growth, TPU demand, and Search revenue trends.

events.title: Amazon Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AWS growth and retail margins test the AI capex narrative and consumer health.
events.what_to_watch: AWS growth, free cash flow, and AI chip commentary.

events.title: US Q3 GDP advance estimate + September PCE
events.why_it_matters: GDPNow tracks Q3 growth at ~3.5%; PCE will confirm whether inflation is cooling into year-end.
events.what_to_watch: GDP vs. 2%-3.5% range, and core PCE m/m.

events.title: ECB rate decision
events.why_it_matters: 70/73 economists expect a hold at 2.50%, with a December hike priced; guidance matters for EUR and bunds.
events.what_to_watch: Lagarde's tone on December and the new staff projections.

events.title: Bank of Japan rate decision + outlook report
events.why_it_matters: Hold at 1.25% expected, but the quarterly outlook and Ueda's presser will signal the December hike path.
events.what_to_watch: Any hint of a December hike and JPY intervention rhetoric.

events.title: Europe-wide port strike (50+ ports, 10 countries)
events.why_it_matters: Even a one-day strike could delay vessel schedules by 3-5 days and raise freight and inventory costs.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the strike is averted and which ports are most affected.

events.title: Apple fiscal Q4 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: iPhone demand and services growth are key for the largest market-cap stock; guidance sets the tone for holiday quarter.
events.what_to_watch: iPhone revenue vs. $111.7-113.7B guide, services margin, and China commentary.

events.title: US midterm elections
events.why_it_matters: Prediction markets put Democratic sweep odds at ~2-in-3; a sweep could hit AI giants and banks while boosting healthcare.
events.what_to_watch: Senate and House control, and post-election policy implications for taxes, AI regulation, and drug pricing.

events.title: US October payrolls report
events.why_it_matters: September payrolls were only +29K; a weak print would complicate the December hike consensus.
events.what_to_watch: Payrolls vs. ~85K consensus and unemployment rate (prior 4.1%).

events.title: Anthropic IPO (targeting mid-November, valuation up to $2T)
events.why_it_matters: A potential record AI IPO would test public-market appetite for frontier AI and could reshape tech valuations.
events.what_to_watch: Final pricing, demand signals, and whether the timeline slips past Thanksgiving.

events.title: Tech selloff; Nasdaq worst week since April 2025
events.why_it_matters: AI capex and valuation concerns are driving a broad de-risking in technology.
events.what_to_watch: Whether mega-cap earnings (Meta, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon) stabilize sentiment.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks; Iran keeps 7-day reopening plan on table
events.why_it_matters: Disruption of the world's most important oil chokepoint keeps an oil-risk premium embedded in prices.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the US accepts Iran's conditions to reopen the strait within seven days.

events.title: OPEC+ holds November production target at 31.01 mb/d
events.why_it_matters: Keeps oil markets tight despite increased Hormuz flows, supporting prices above $100.
events.what_to_watch: Compliance and whether OPEC+ calls an emergency meeting if Hormuz reopens.

top_risks: FOMC (Oct 27-28) delivers a hawkish surprise by signaling a December hike with more conviction than priced, pressuring duration-sensitive growth stocks.
A Democratic sweep in the November 3 midterms triggers a violent sector rotation, hitting AI giants, banks, and energy while boosting healthcare.
Strait of Hormuz disruption escalates or Iran-US talks collapse, spiking oil above current levels and reigniting global inflation fears.
Mega-cap earnings (Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Apple) disappoint on AI capex returns or cloud growth, extending the October tech selloff.
The Europe-wide port strike on October 30 disrupts supply chains longer than expected, adding to goods inflation and inventory costs.
top_opportunities: A confirmed FOMC hold with dovish language could spark a relief rally in rate-sensitive growth and small caps.
Jio Platforms' record IPO and a strong Anthropic listing could reopen the IPO window and boost risk appetite for tech.
US-China trade de-escalation locks in a stable backdrop for semiconductors and industrials through January 2027.
Healthcare could outperform on a Democratic sweep, given drug-pricing and ACA tailwinds.
Oil-price volatility from Hormuz creates trading opportunities in energy equities and options.
summary: Markets enter the final week of October with a dovish Fed on hold, sticky inflation, and a US-China trade truce that removes the November 1 tail risk. Mega-cap earnings, the October 28 FOMC, and the November 3 midterms dominate the upcoming window, while Strait of Hormuz disruption and a Europe-wide port strike keep supply-chain risks alive. The main tension is between a market pricing a benign Fed hold and a data-dependent path that could force a December hike.
